examples.english: The washing machine is broken today.

examples.arabic: الفطار مش جاهز و الغسالة كانت بايظة طول الليل
examples.english: Breakfast isn't ready and the washing machine was broken all night.
examples.transliteration: El fetar mesh gahez wel ghassala kanet bayza tool el leil.

examples.arabic: صحيت الصبح ولقيت الغسالة بايظة خالص
examples.english: I woke up in the morning and found the washing machine completely broken.
examples.transliteration: Saḥeet eṣ-ṣobḥ wel'eet el-ghassāla bayẓa khāleṣ.

examples.arabic: صباح النور يا ام علي الغسالة بتاعتي بايظة والهدوم مكومة عندي بقالها ايام
examples.english: Good morning, Umm Ali, my washing machine is broken and the clothes have been piled up for days.
examples.transliteration: Sabah el-noor ya Om Ali, el-ghassāla beta'ty bayẓa wel-hedoom mekawwama 'andy ba'alha ayyam.
